meta.title: Svity — one card a day to meet yourself
meta.description: A quiet daily ritual with the metaphorical card deck “Svity”: a card, a question, a few minutes for yourself. And a room where psychologists work with the cards together with their clients.

6: What would this paper boat carry if it sailed away from you?
What in your life is fragile, yet still stays afloat?
What do you see in the reflection that you miss in reality?
11: Whom or what would you like to hold just like this, with your eyes closed?
Which part of you needs this same tenderness?
How does your body tell you that you are safe?
12: Who are you in this card: the one holding or the one being held?
Who keeps you afloat, even when you don't notice it?
What would help you trust others with your weight, even a little?
20: If one of these keys were the one you need right now, which door would it open?
Which keys are already in your pocket while you keep looking for new ones?
Who could help you find the right key?
21: What do you see deep in this garden, and what draws you there?
What in your life is already blooming, though it once seemed hopeless?
What do you need to take the first step under this arch?
22: What is written in the open book lying here?
What must be in your cozy corner, and what will definitely not be there?
What do you want to hide from, and what do you simply want to rest from?
23: What does this bridge connect in your life, and what lies beneath it in the mist?
What do you already know about the far side without seeing it?
What one step can you take without knowing the whole way?
25: What do you see beyond this window, and what do you long for as you look out?
What in your life needs 'fresh air'?
Which window do you keep shut, and what would happen if you opened it?

principles.title: A mirror, not a prophecy
principles.p1: Cards predict nothing. They are a mirror: an image and a question to meet yourself through.
principles.p2: Write a word, a page, or nothing. Every moment with a card counts.
principles.p3: Your diary is private, even from your psychologist.

how.title: 3–5 minutes. No streaks.
how.sub: Come back when it helps. Missing a day is not a failure.
how.s1: One tap: calm, hope, tiredness, anxiety…
how.s2: Tap the deck and watch the star wake up.
how.s3: One of three questions written for this card.
how.s4: A word, a page, or simply a moment.
how.s5: One more tap, and the card stays in your diary.

diary.title: Your month in cards
diary.sub: Every card stays in your diary with its question, your note and how you felt before and after.
diary.entryQuestion: What in your life needs “fresh air”?
diary.entryNote: My evenings. Maybe a walk after work, without the phone…
diary.insight: After a card, it felt lighter in 5 of 7 entries.

shadow.title: Shadow cards
shadow.sub: After a month of practice, you can open cards about anger, sadness and fear: only if you choose to, and never for money.
shadow.i1: They open after 30 days and 10 entries, with your consent
shadow.i2: After each one: a breath and a supporting card
shadow.i3: You can turn them off at any time

pros.title: A room for your sessions
pros.sub: Send a link. Your client draws cards on their phone; you see only the cards they choose to share.
pros.f1: 1 or 3 cards: What is · What's in the way · What will help
pros.f3: Prompts and deepening questions, only for you
pros.f5: A question for the week, sent to your client's diary
pros.f6: Questions in your client's language, whatever yours is
pros.mockNote: Warmth, family. Ask about the kitchen.

safety.title: Care is built in
safety.s1: On every screen, with support lines for your country.
safety.s2: A soft card and a breath instead of a question.
safety.s3: Any card can be put back. Nothing is recorded.

langs.title: Ukrainian and English at launch
langs.sub: Six more languages are on the way, for Ukrainians across Europe and their psychologists.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.a1: No. Metaphorical cards are a tool psychologists use to work with images. A card is a reason to ask yourself a question; there are no right answers.
faq.a2: No. The daily card works on its own. If you have a psychologist, you can also work with the cards together in a session room.
faq.a3: The daily card, the diary, check-ins and help are free. Extra practices will be part of Svity Plus.
faq.a4: The code in the box will unlock Svity Plus for 12 months.
faq.a5: Ukrainian and English at launch; German, Polish, Czech, Italian, Spanish and French soon.
faq.a6: Right now: create an account, it's free.
faq.q7: I'm a psychologist. How do I start working with clients?
faq.a7: Create an account and choose “As a psychologist”, or turn on “Sessions with clients” in your profile. The cabinet with rooms opens right away, free during the beta.

footer.tagline: One card a day to meet yourself.
footer.about: An author's deck of 117 painted cards and 351 questions, with a diary that remembers how you felt and a room for sessions with your psychologist.
footer.soon: Six more languages are coming: Deutsch, Polski, Čeština, Italiano, Español, Français.
footer.crisis: Svity is a space for reflection, not therapy or emergency help. If you are in danger, call 112 (in Ukraine and across Europe) or your local emergency number.
footer.made: Made with care in Ukrainian and English
